opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000; in special cases up to £750,000; most grants below £300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to research projects addressing one or more of the five priority questions, hosted by UK-based organisations. Will not fund individuals without formal employment/contractual relationship with the hosting institution, individuals unaffiliated to an organisation, projects led by schools/FE colleges, undergraduates or master's students, PhD fees, establishment of academic posts, ongoing costs, dissemination-only projects, local charities, or projects led by non-UK based organisations (exceptional overseas cases considered).
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five interconnected priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to research on racial diversity within the UK. Encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly from individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities; strongly encourages partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society. Priority theme for 2026: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK. One deadline a year in Autumn.
